newsitem.title: USA: Lou D'Andrea leaves JB Hanauer post - mkt sources.
newsitem.headline: Lou D'Andrea leaves JB Hanauer post - mkt sources.

text.p: Louis D'Andrea, a senior vice president and manager of JB Hanauer & Co's municipal institutional department, resigned Monday, market sources said Tuesday.
"He's a professional of the highest caliber, and somebody who I am going to miss working with," said one market source who described himself "a long-time friend."
Ken Meiselman, executive vice president and manager of JB Hanauer's municipal trading department, said D'Andrea and the firm parted ways by "mutual agreement."
Meiselman said he will take charge of the institutional department overall, while vice president Douglas McDowell will be promoted to institutional sales manager.
Philip Dillon, who was co-manager of JB Hanauer's institutional department along with D'Andrea, will remain on as a salesman.
"That's also under mutual agreement," Meiselman said.
